A true town centre, Pacific Epping is a thriving lifestyle hub north of the Melbourne CBD; a place where shopping, dining, entertainment and essential public services converge.

This family-focused destination is easily accessed via the M80 Ring Road and Hume Highway, making it well-placed to capitalise on the region’s steady annual population growth.

Retail

Host to multiple supermarkets and a number of big-name lifestyle retailers including Big W, Kmart and Bed Bath N Table, Pacific Epping represents a one-stop shop for the young families making their home in Melbourne’s outer north.

 

In addition to leading apparel brands, the centre is beloved for its extensive cinema complex and alfresco dining precinct. An on-site childcare centre also helps streamline daily life for local parents.

Fresh food marketplace

Revitalised in 2024, Hunter & Gatherer takes inspiration from Melbourne’s vibrant open-air markets, providing a dynamic mix of 20 culinary experiences and retail offerings to celebrate the multicultural vibrancy of Melbourne’s outer suburbs.

Hotel
Quest Epping apartments & hotel

Quest Epping opened opposite the centre in 2018, introducing conference facilities and serviced apartment accommodation to serve the suburb’s growing business community as well as the visiting friends and family market.

Featuring 96 apartments, the hotel is within close proximity of Northern Hospital and only 20 minutes’ drive from Melbourne Airport.
